name: Notion
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: E@B startup-network partner link; Business/AI trials for member startups; club workspace support separately.
roles: Startup Partnerships Manager / Head of Startups; Community Partnerships
why: Startup partner and Builders programs explicitly serve networks/audiences.
route: Partners page > Startup Partner Program or Builders Program.
caveat: Published startup trials are not automatically club workspace benefits. Existing paying users and company eligibility affect access.

name: Linear
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: Dedicated E@B partner redemption link; up to 6-month startup trial; build-and-ship workshop.
roles: Startup Program Manager / Ecosystem Partnerships; Community Lead
why: Official program explicitly includes startup communities as partners.
route: Startups page > Become a Startup Program partner.
caveat: Offers apply to eligible affiliated companies, not all club members or the club itself.

name: ElevenLabs
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: Credits/in-kind prizes for an in-person campus hackathon; voice-AI demo workshop; founder grants referrals.
roles: Education / Student Programs; Community Partnerships; Developer Relations
why: Students page explicitly invites campus hackathon partnerships.
route: Students page > Hackathons & Events; separate Startup Grants path for companies.
caveat: Grants require long-term monetized startup use, not one-off event projects; avoid promising club-wide paid subscriptions.

name: GitHub
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: E@B as startup ecosystem partner; startup developer-tool benefits; student OSS/build events.
roles: GitHub for Startups Partnerships; GitHub Education / Developer Relations
why: Partner application includes Startup Ecosystem Partner; published partner list includes student entrepreneurship organizations.
route: GitHub for Startups partner application.
caveat: Approval required. Startup partner route is different from individual Student Developer Pack benefits.

name: Vercel / v0
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: Partner referral channel for member startups; deployment workshop; ask for separate v0 hackathon credits.
roles: Startup Partnerships; Developer Relations / Community; v0 Community
why: Vercel has a startups team and explicit partner-interest route; useful for student MVPs.
route: Startups page > Contact the Startups Team / joining as a partner.
caveat: Startup eligibility and partnership proof apply. Current Flex Commit terms include v0; request a separate event pool for club members who do not qualify.

name: MongoDB
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: E@B startup referral partnership with Atlas/Voyage AI benefits plus technical office hours.
roles: MongoDB for Startups / Startup Partnerships; Developer Relations
why: Official page solicits partners supporting founders.
route: Startups page > Partner with MongoDB; startups@mongodb.com.
caveat: Published route usually uses VC/accelerator referrals; confirm whether E@B qualifies as a community partner.

name: Algolia
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: E@B startup-program partner access; search/RAG build workshop and credits for eligible ventures.
roles: Startup Program Manager / Ecosystem Partnerships; Developer Relations
why: Official page invites startup programs and incubators to distribute its offer.
route: Industries/startups page > Partner with Algolia > reach out.
caveat: Published offer is for qualifying startups, new/free users and no prior coupon; not a transferable club credit pool.

name: Datadog
tier: First wave: direct community/partner fit
angle: Partner referral link for member startups; monitoring workshop and startup credits.
roles: Datadog for Startups Partnerships; Developer Advocacy
why: Official startup partner mailbox is published; useful when ventures reach deployment.
route: ddfspartners@datadoghq.com.
caveat: Companies must be Series A or earlier, new to Datadog and referred by an approved partner. Club acceptance is unconfirmed.

name: OpenAI
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Campus Network club partnership, hands-on Codex/API workshop, event credits; startup credits referral options separately.
roles: Campus Network / Education Partnerships; Developer Relations; Startup Partnerships
why: Official club-interest route is better aligned than asking a sales team for a blanket discount.
route: Student club interest form; startups page for founder resources.
caveat: Startup credits run through eligible VC partners. Club-interest form does not promise a discount or sponsorship contract.

name: Anthropic
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Claude build night with credits/prizes, speaker support; founder program referrals.
roles: Campus / Education Partnerships; Developer Relations; Startup Ecosystem Partnerships
why: Campus and startup programs show relevant audiences and possible event relationships.
route: Claude for Startups apply route; campus team for club collaboration.
caveat: Founders can apply without VC backing, but credit eligibility varies. Campus ambassador September cycle is closed; event sponsorship is a separate ask.

name: Cursor
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Cursor build workshop, club-cohosted event funding, temporary event licenses or student benefit distribution.
roles: Campus Programs / Community; Developer Relations
why: Campus Leads explicitly co-host with student clubs and receive event resources.
route: students@cursor.com; Campus Leads interest page.
caveat: Campus program reopening does not block a separate club partnership inquiry. No E@B-exclusive discount is verified.

name: Replit
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Prompt-to-product workshop with event credits and startup demos.
roles: Community / Ambassador Program; Developer Relations; Partnerships
why: Official community program supports events and builders with credits.
route: community@repl.it.
caveat: Ambassador intake copy conflicts; ask for direct event collaboration without assuming selection or a club discount.

name: AWS
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Activate access for eligible member ventures; startup office hours and build-event credits.
roles: AWS Activate / Startup Business Development; University or Developer Relations
why: Activate manages provider-distributed benefits; DevRel can support learning events.
route: AWS Activate Providers page > provider application / Contact us.
caveat: Provider criteria emphasize VCs, seed investors and accelerators actively investing. E@B may need an accelerator partner rather than qualify alone.

name: Google Cloud
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Startup Cloud Program referral path for founders; Firebase/AI workshops; scoped event credit request.
roles: Startup Ecosystem / Google for Startups Cloud; Developer Relations; Education Partnerships
why: Official startup ecosystem has credits and partner perks.
route: Startup Perks page and startup team routes.
caveat: Startup program credits and tier-exclusive perks are for eligible companies. A club-exclusive code is not a published entitlement.

name: Microsoft
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Azure/startup onboarding session, technical speaker, event credits and founder benefits referral.
roles: Microsoft for Startups / Ecosystem Partnerships; Student Ambassador team; Developer Relations
why: Startup and student programs offer distinct founder and learning benefits.
route: Microsoft for Startups page > sign up; student program for campus community.
caveat: Use current Microsoft for Startups branding; do not assume old Founders Hub benefits or blanket club eligibility.

name: NVIDIA
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Inception onboarding for member AI startups; Deep Learning Institute workshop/training access and technical speaker.
roles: Inception Program / Startup Ecosystem; Developer Relations; University Relations
why: Inception provides startup tools/training and partner offers; education contacts suit workshops.
route: Inception page > program application / contact.
caveat: Inception needs incorporated companies, working websites and at least one developer. It is not a student club GPU-credit grant.

name: Cloudflare
tier: Second wave: campus events + gated startup benefits
angle: Workers build workshop with small event credit pool; founder program referrals and affiliate-partner discussion.
roles: Cloudflare for Startups / Startup Partnerships; Developer Advocacy
why: Official startup credits and developer platform are relevant to shipping MVPs.
route: Cloudflare Startups application/program page.
caveat: Startup program has for-profit/company eligibility and partner/funding-dependent tiers; do not promise a club package.

name: Supabase
tier: Exploratory: negotiate a new club offer
angle: Weekend MVP workshop, mentor/office hours, project credits or short Pro trial for winners.
roles: Developer Relations / Community; Partnerships
why: Product fits student full-stack prototypes; official partner ecosystem provides a routing lead.
route: Partner with Supabase page; developer/community team.
caveat: No blanket startup credit or campus discount offer verified from the current official startup-solutions page. This is a proposed ask.

name: Canva
tier: Exploratory: event support more plausible than exclusive codes
angle: Pitch-deck/design workshop with event support from Community Fund; ask about a creator-led club collaboration.
roles: Community Programs / Community Fund; Education Partnerships
why: Official Community Fund lists Canva education events for professors and students as an event idea.
route: Community page > Canva Community Fund > apply with event details.
caveat: Canvassador applications open periodically; no specific open intake or E@B-exclusive trial verified. Fund approval is separate from ambassador status.

name: Figma
tier: Exploratory: add value beyond existing student access
angle: Startup prototyping workshop, mentor/design review, swag or demo-night prizes.
roles: Education Partnerships / Education Community; Developer Relations
why: Figma already offers education tools, so practical programming is a better incremental ask than a generic student discount.
route: Figma for Education page; approach education/community team.
caveat: Verified student/educator access already exists. Commercial startup use must be checked against education terms; no custom club deal is promised.
